notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T145249Z. The BLS PPI, CPI and average-price series carry September 2026. Prose not yet written. The derived mandatory-block less CME spread could not be computed at all: no week is covered by both series yet, the NDPSR block week ending 2026-10-10 against the CME week ending 2026-10-16. The NDPSR 500-pound barrel series no longer carries a price; the last published figure, 1.9495 for the week ending 2025-05-31, is held as a historical series and is not a current reading.
